```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

# Task 3 — Real Dataset: Solar System Planets

Dataset source:  
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonination/planets/master/planets.csv

```{r}
solar <- read_csv("solar_system_planets.csv")
glimpse(solar)
head(solar)
summary(solar)
```

## Group by planet type
```{r}
if("type" %in% colnames(solar)) {
  planet_groups <- solar %>% 
    group_by(type) %>% 
    summarise(
      avg_mass = mean(mass, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_radius = mean(radius, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n()
    )
  planet_groups
}
```

## Terrestrial planets
```{r}
terrestrial <- solar %>% filter(type == "Terrestrial")
terrestrial
```

## Density index
```{r}
solar_with_density <- solar %>% 
  mutate(density_index = mass / radius)

head(solar_with_density)
```
